title: Which Reality Show Would You Win?
description: Somewhere out there is a trophy with your name on it. Which competition crowns you champion?

answers.text: Whip up appetizers from whatever exists. Somehow gourmet.
Prioritize ruthlessly: bathroom, entryway, done
Light candles, dim lamps, call it ambiance
Full transformation. Guests can wait.

questions.text: Twenty minutes until guests arrive and the house is chaos. You:

answers.text: A timer, limited ingredients, and judges
Rain, a tarp, and figuring it out
A stage, a spotlight, one shot
Rapid-fire questions, buzzer in hand

questions.text: Pick a childhood claim to fame:

answers.text: You genuinely don't mind being uncomfortable
Nerves make you better, not worse
You see the finished version before you start
You remember everything. Everything.
A wooden spoon with history
A framed photo of the crowd mid-cheer
It IS the shelf. You built it.

questions.text: The trophy goes on your shelf. Next to it:

results.description: Give you a timer, a mystery basket, and a skeptical judge, and you thrive. You create under pressure, improvise like a legend, and feed people victory.
You see the 'after' while everyone's still staring at the 'before.' Vision, hustle, and an eye for transformation — the big reveal is your natural habitat.
Spotlights were invented for you. One shot, big stage, zero fear — you don't just perform under pressure, you're better because of it.
Your brain is the trophy case. Facts stick to you, recall is instant, and buzzer speed is your love language. Final answer: champion.
Rain, mud, and a broken tent are just Tuesday to you. Resourceful, resilient, and unbothered by discomfort, you'd outlast everyone — cheerfully.
